findings.claim: Ruling (b) changes what the second tree receives, but D-46's Where list (gauntlet-design.md:398; landing-design.md:118-119, :178, :181, :378) leaves out two normative lines that still say the previous tree's whole gauntlet/ is copied: the Homes row 'What the second tree holds' at :492 and the copy-rule inventory at :17.
findings.failure_scenario: The ruling is applied to the lines D-46 names, so copy-in at :378 skips the verdict, review, reply, grounds and rebased files. The Homes row at :492 still says copy-in copies 'the previous tree's whole gauntlet/' and calls that the one home. The next convergence pass then finds the design contradicting itself and opens a new group to re-decide a question already ruled, which spends a round on it (CLAUDE.md 1.3).
